mainEntity.name: How much does an outdoor sauna cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the size, the heater and your site. Our best-selling Pure Cube 552 is $11,884. Delivery, the base and electrical work vary by property, so we give every customer a personalized quote after a consultation.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your municipality. In Toronto, for example, a building permit is generally required for an accessory structure larger than 10 m² (107 sq ft), or one that's attached to your house or has plumbing. Electrical work must be done by a licensed electrician. We'll help you check your local rules before you buy.

mainEntity.name: Where do you deliver and install?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ontario and British Columbia. In the GTA we install in Toronto, Mississauga, Oakville, Burlington, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Markham, Aurora, King and Whitby, and across Ontario from Niagara-on-the-Lake and Prince Edward County to Collingwood, Muskoka and Haliburton. Sauna delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario. We also install in British Columbia, and anywhere outside Ontario is quoted on request.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an outdoor sauna in a Canadian winter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely, winter is the best season for it. Our saunas are built from premium Canadian cedar and sized with heaters that bring them up to temperature year-round.
Yes. We design custom outdoor saunas and indoor sauna rooms for homes, cottages and rentals. Tell us about your space and we'll come back with a design and quote.
The installation itself usually takes about 5 to 6 hours on site. From the day you order to installation day is typically 2 to 4 weeks, and we confirm your date when you order.
